g.text: Multimodal Behavioural Analysis Platform · Privacy-Preserving Edge AI · Full-Stack Research Architecture
• Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui Component Primitives
• Live WebCam & Audio Input Capture via MediaStream API
• Interactive Analytics (Recharts), PDF viewer, Audit pages
Models run locally in browser memory — no raw video leaves device
• Web Audio API mono channel capture
• Resampled to 16 kHz 16-bit PCM WAV in memory
• Raw photos & pose video NEVER leave the browser.
• Only numeric landmark coordinates are sent.
• Audio uploaded ONLY after explicit subject confirmation.
• Audio processed in RAM only, zero disk storage.
• HS256 JWT Authentication with Database Session Revocation (JTI table)
• Bcrypt password hashing (cost 12) · Brute-force lockout & IP limiter
• Strict Pydantic v2 validation · CORS & CSP headers (`default-src none`)
Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR, Soukupová & Čech) · Landmark midline symmetry index · Iris/pupil ratio
Speed normalized by shoulder-width (BW/s) · Velocity CV · FFT Tremor frequency (0.25–7.5 Hz)
YIN pitch tracking (F0 median/std in semitones) · 13 MFCC coefficients (26 mel-filterbanks)
Spectral centroid, rolloff & flatness · SNR estimate · Speech pause duration segmentation
14-Feature Matrix: Deterministic feature integration (Face + Motion + Voice)
Missing Modality Handler: Native missing states — NO zero-fill/imputation bias
Real Sessions: Unbiased reporting ("No reliable estimate available" — honest science)
Synthetic Demo: Hand-set weighted sigmoid classifier for synthetic testing sessions
ReportLab Engine: High-fidelity, tamper-evident PDF export with legal disclaimers
• 201 Backend Automated Pytest tests (in-memory SQLite + MySQL)
• SQL Query Parameter hiding (`hide_parameters=True`) preventing log leaks
• CSV injection sanitization (=, +, -, @ escaped) & Alembic Downgrade guards
Withdrawing consent automatically purges all linked records.
Automated atomic purge of sessions past `retain_until` date.
Alembic blocks downgrades that would cause silent data loss.
Zero Raw Media Uploaded (Browser Edge AI)
